# Klique Documentation

> End-to-end platform for streamlining AI development and deployment

This file contains links to documentation sections following the llmstxt.org standard.

## Table of Contents

- [Agentic Interface](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/agentic_interface.md): How AI agents such as Claude Code or Cursor connect to the Klique MCP server and use its tools and skills to work with Klique.
- [Agentic Generated Applications](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/ai_engine/agentic_generated_applications.md): How Klique onboards user-built applications, including agentic coding tool output, as managed, catalog-ready applications.
- [AI Engine](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/ai_engine.md): Klique's AI Engine, the gateway and toolset spanning model building, deployment, serving, and custom application publishing.
- [Agentic Desktop Applications](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/ai_engine/desktop_agentic_applications.md): Klique's managed desktop environments for agentic tools such as Claude Desktop and ChatGPT, run centrally on governed compute.
- [AI MLOps Workbench](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/ai_engine/klique_ai_workbench.md): Klique's AI MLOps Workbench for experiment tracking, hyperparameter optimization, model registry, and dataset versioning with Hyper-Datasets.
- [Remote Agentic Development Environment](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/ai_engine/remote_agentic_development_environment.md): Klique's browser-based remote development environment, pairing VS Code with agentic coding CLIs like Claude Code and Codex on managed compute.
- [ClearML SDK](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/clearml_sdk.md): Core ClearML SDK concepts Klique uses, including projects, tasks, hyperparameters, artifacts, models, pipelines, and datasets.
- [Client Configuration](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/configs/client_configuration.md): The configuration precedence order (CLI arguments, environment variables, configuration vault, clearml.conf) used by the ClearML SDK and Agent.
- [Air-Gapped Environments](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/air_gapped_env.md): How to run Klique in air-gapped environments, including hosting offline dependencies, private registries, and image pull secrets for Kubernetes.
- [Setting up API Auditing](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/api_audit.md): How to enable and configure Klique API audit logging via stdout, Fluentd, or Elasticsearch adapters, including per-endpoint and field-level controls.
- [Custom Applications](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/app_custom.md): Building and installing custom Klique applications: config file format, launch form wizard fields, dashboard layout, and the custom apps agent.
- [External Applications Server Installation](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/app_install_ex_server.md): How to install and configure an external server to host Klique application instances using the apps agent, separate from the Klique Server.
- [Application Installation on On-Prem and VPC Servers](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/app_install_ubuntu_on_prem.md): Installing Klique applications on on-premises and VPC docker-compose servers using upload_apps.py, including air-gapped image registry conversion.
- [Application Launch Form Customization](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/app_launch_form_custom.md): Overriding Klique application launch form properties (dropdown options, defaults, placeholders) via the app_wizard_overrides server configuration.
- [Application Instance Visibility Policy](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/app_visibility_policy.md): How to configure Klique application instance visibility policies (all, owner, or group) globally, per application, or per tenant.
- [Docker-Compose Deployment](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/appgw_install_compose.md): Docker-compose installation of the AI Application Gateway and the LLM Gateway it fronts, for self-managed Klique Server and workload node setups.
- [Docker-Compose - Hosted Server](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/appgw_install_compose_hosted.md): Docker-compose installation of the AI Application Gateway router and LLM Gateway for a Klique hosted control plane with self-hosted workload nodes.
- [Kubernetes Deployment](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/appgw_install_k8s.md): Installing the Klique AI Application Gateway on Kubernetes via Helm, including namespace requirements and ingress or NodePort exposure.
- [Application Installation on Kubernetes](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/apps_k8s.md): Installing Klique applications on a Kubernetes-based Klique Server, including air-gapped image registry conversion and uploading application packages.
- [Changing Klique Artifacts Links](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/change_artifact_links.md): Using the fix_fileserver_urls.py script to update artifact storage references in Klique's MongoDB and ElasticSearch after migrating external storage.
- [Container and Pod Debugging](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/container_debug.md): Debugging workflows for Klique deployments on Kubernetes and Docker Compose, including ephemeral debug containers and air-gapped debug image handling.
- [Deleting Tenants](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/delete_tenant.md): The step-by-step procedure for deleting a tenant's data from MongoDB, Elasticsearch, and the Fileserver.
- [API Credentials Expiration Policy](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/extra_configs/api_cred_expiration_policy.md): How administrators restrict the maximum API credential expiration period using an apiserver environment variable.
- [Backup](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/extra_configs/backups.md): Recommended backup practices for Klique's File Server, Elasticsearch, and MongoDB storage components on Kubernetes and on-premise deployments.
- [Customizing the Klique Web UI](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/extra_configs/customizing_ui.md): The environment variable parameters for customizing and white labeling the Klique Web UI, including branding, theming, and login behavior.
- [Event Metering](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/extra_configs/event_metering.md): Klique's event metering service for defining custom usage metrics, reporting them, and querying aggregated usage and cost data.
- [Klique K8s Collector](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/extra_configs/k8s_collector.md): The resource-metrics-collector Helm chart, which scrapes Kubernetes cluster metrics and forwards them to the Klique Server's Hardware Dashboard.
- [Monitoring (K8s)](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/extra_configs/monitoring_k8s.md): Recommended practices for monitoring a Kubernetes-based Klique deployment, including API server logging and the orchestration metrics exporter.
- [Monitoring (VM / Docker Deployment)](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/extra_configs/monitoring_vm_docker.md): Recommended practices for monitoring a Klique deployment on AWS VPC or on-premise VM/Docker, covering hardware, service availability, and backups.
- [Platform Management Center](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/extra_configs/platform_management_center_deploy.md): How to deploy the Platform Management Center on Kubernetes, including control plane credentials and admin authentication setup.
- [Klique S3 Presign Service](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/extra_configs/presign_service.md): The Klique Presign Service, which lets WebApp users access S3-like storage from the browser without configuring S3 credentials.
- [Deployment with Self-Signed Certificates](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/extra_configs/self_signed_certificates.md): Configuring the AI Application Gateway and Klique Orchestrator to use self-signed or custom CA certificates.
- [Amazon Cognito OAuth](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/extra_configs/sso/sso_amazon_cognito_oauth.md): How to configure Amazon Cognito as an OAuth identity provider for Klique Single Sign-On.
- [Azure AD OAuth](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/extra_configs/sso/sso_azure_ad_oauth.md): How to register Klique as an Azure AD OAuth application and configure the Klique Server environment variables for SSO.
- [Duo SAML](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/extra_configs/sso/sso_duo_saml.md): How to configure Duo as a SAML identity provider for Klique SSO, including IdP metadata and Klique Server environment variables.
- [Google OAuth](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/extra_configs/sso/sso_google_oauth.md): How to register Klique as a Google OAuth client and configure the Klique Server environment variables for SSO.
- [Google SAML](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/extra_configs/sso/sso_google_saml.md): How to configure Google as a SAML identity provider for Klique SSO, including docker-compose and Kubernetes setup.
- [JumpCloud SAML](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/extra_configs/sso/sso_jumpcloud_saml.md): How to configure JumpCloud as a SAML identity provider for Klique SSO, including IdP metadata and Klique Server environment variables.
- [Keycloak OAuth](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/extra_configs/sso/sso_keycloak_oauth.md): How to configure Keycloak as an OAuth identity provider for Klique SSO, including group sync and admin role mapping.
- [LDAP](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/extra_configs/sso/sso_ldap.md): How to configure Klique to authenticate users against an LDAP or Active Directory server, including TLS, group sync, and user whitelisting.
- [Microsoft AD OAuth](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/extra_configs/sso/sso_microsoft_ad_oauth.md): How to configure Microsoft Active Directory as an OAuth identity provider for Klique SSO.
- [Microsoft AD SAML (Including Azure SAML)](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/extra_configs/sso/sso_microsoft_ad_saml.md): How to configure Microsoft Active Directory, including Azure SAML, as a SAML identity provider for Klique SSO, with group sync.
- [Okta OAuth](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/extra_configs/sso/sso_okta_oauth.md): How to configure Okta as an OAuth identity provider for Klique SSO, including Klique Server environment variable setup.
- [Ping Identity OAuth](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/extra_configs/sso/sso_ping_id_oauth.md): How to configure Ping Identity as an OAuth identity provider for Klique SSO, including group and admin role sync.
- [Accurate Vulnerability Scanning of Klique Images](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/image_vulnerability_scanning.md): How to scan Klique's hardened container images using Docker Scout or other scanners with SBOM and VEX metadata to avoid false-positive CVEs.
- [Project Migration](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/import_projects.md): Exporting projects from a ClearML open source server or a Klique Server and importing them into a Klique Server, with file server artifacts.
- [Kubernetes](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/k8s.md): Step-by-step instructions for installing the Klique Server control plane on Kubernetes using the Klique Helm chart.
- [Klique for HPC](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/klique_for_hpc.md): Native Slurm and PBS support, the login-node orchestrator install, container execution modes, user impersonation, and Slurm on Kubernetes.
- [Klique for Kubernetes](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/klique_for_kubernetes.md): Klique's Kubernetes components across control plane, workload plane and platform services, plus configuration and validated distributions.
- [Multi-Tenant Service on Kubernetes](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/multi_tenant_k8s.md): Installing a Klique multi-tenant service on Kubernetes, including tenant creation, SSO sign-in rules, and feature and group configuration.
- [On-Premises on Ubuntu](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/on_prem_ubuntu.md): Installing the Klique Server on a single Ubuntu server with Docker Compose, including prerequisites, security, backups, and troubleshooting.
- [OpenShift](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/openshift.md): Klique Server and Application Gateway installation on OpenShift with Ingress or Route networking, restricted security contexts, and troubleshooting.
- [Multi-Tenant Login Mode](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/sso_multi_tenant_login.md): Configuring multi-tenant SSO login, mapping an external identity provider's tenants to Klique tenants and their sign-in routing.
- [AWS VPC](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_klique/vpc_aws.md): Installing the Klique Server on AWS within a VPC, covering security groups, EC2 instance setup, load balancer configuration, and backups.
- [One-click Inference Service](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/deploying_models.md): Klique's self-service model deployment applications, which turn trained models into monitored inference endpoints.
- [FAQ](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/faq.md): Frequently asked questions covering what Klique is, deployment, security, access, orchestration, governance, and GenAI capabilities.
- [Building Interactive Model Demos](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/getting_started/building_interactive_demos.md): Building interactive model demos with the Gradio and Streamlit apps, including app instance setup and the resulting externally accessible link.
- [Deploying Model Endpoints](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/getting_started/deploying_model_endpoints.md): The workflow for deploying a model as a live endpoint with Klique's vLLM, Embedding, Llama.cpp, SGLang, and NVIDIA NIM apps, or clearml-serving.
- [Managing Experiments](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/getting_started/experiment_management.md): Instrumenting, tracking, comparing, reproducing, and organizing training runs in Klique, then registering the resulting models.
- [Launching an Agentic Coding Session](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/getting_started/launching_agentic_session.md): Launching an agentic coding CLI session on managed compute, working with the MCP server, and returning to a previous session.
- [Launching a Remote IDE](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/getting_started/launching_remote_ide.md): Launching an SSH, JupyterLab, VS Code, or virtual machine remote desktop session on managed compute, its launch configuration, and returning to a p...
- [Scheduling and Triggering Task Execution](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/getting_started/task_trigger_schedule.md): Scheduling and event-based triggering of task execution using the Task Scheduler and Trigger Manager applications or SDK.
- [Token Limit and Quota Control](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/getting_started/token_quota_control.md): How an AI Admin sets gateway-wide, model, user, and group-level token quotas and rate limits through the LLM Gateway, and what happens at the limit.
- [Use Cases](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/getting_started/use_cases.md): Workflow guides for experiments, model endpoints, remote IDEs, interactive demos, custom apps, task scheduling, token quotas, and agentic sessions.
- [Governance Engine](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/governance_engine.md): The Governance Engine, Klique's unified security, policy, and identity layer spanning access, cost, and compliance controls.
- [Guardrails](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/governance_engine/guardrails.md): How Klique secures deployed models with authenticated endpoints, role-based model access, and NeMo Guardrails content safety rails.
- [Model Governance](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/governance_engine/model_governance.md): Model governance in Klique, covering the Model Endpoints dashboard, access controls on endpoints, and per-user usage quotas.
- [RBAC](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/governance_engine/rbac.md): Klique's role-based access control, including access rules, user groups, and service accounts within a tenant.
- [Resource Governance](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/governance_engine/resource_governance.md): Klique's resource governance over shared compute, including quotas, resource policies, spillover, and usage cost accountability.
- [Tokenomics](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/governance_engine/tokenomics.md): Klique's tokenomics capabilities for controlling LLM model access, quotas, and cost visibility through the LLM Gateway.
- [Usage Metering & Billing](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/governance_engine/usage_metering_billing.md): Klique's usage metering and billing, covering tracked categories, cost attribution, and integration with external billing systems.
- [Vector DB and Data Management](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/hyper_datasets.md): Klique's Hyper-Datasets for unstructured and vector data management, the built-in vector database, and on-demand Milvus and Qdrant deployments.
- [Annotation Tasks](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/hyperdatasets_webapp/annotator.md): The Annotations page for creating and managing annotation tasks and using the frame viewer to annotate images and video.
- [Hyper-Datasets Page](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/hyperdatasets_webapp/datasets.md): The Hyper-Datasets page for browsing, filtering, and managing hyper-datasets and creating new ones.

- [Dataset Versions](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/hyperdatasets_webapp/datasets_versioning.md): The dataset versioning WebApp for viewing, creating, filtering, and managing hyper-dataset versions and their frames.
- [The Dataview Table](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/hyperdatasets_webapp/dataviews.md): The Dataview table for viewing, creating, customizing, and managing Dataviews associated with a project.

- [Platform Administration](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/klique_maintenance.md): Platform Administration: the Platform Management Center, migration, tenant lifecycle, backup, security, debugging, and monitoring.
- [Klique Setup](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/klique_setup.md): Klique Setup: the one-time tasks for choosing a deployment target and bringing a Klique deployment online.
- [Model Registry](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/model_registry.md): The Klique model registry, covering registering, analyzing, querying, and serving models through the ClearML SDK and web UI.
- [Cloud Autoscaling](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/orchestration_engine/cloud_autoscaling.md): Klique's cloud autoscaling, including its benefits and the AWS and GCP autoscaler applications that provision instances on demand.
- [Fractional GPUs](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/orchestration_engine/fractional_gpus.md): Klique's approaches to fractional GPU allocation, including static and dynamic MIG, container-level memory limits, and AMD GPU partitioning.
- [Remote Development Environment](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/orchestration_engine/gpuaas_remote_ides.md): Klique's remote development environment applications, which provide interactive IDE and desktop sessions on managed compute.
- [HPC](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/orchestration_engine/hpc.md): Klique's HPC integration with Slurm and PBS schedulers through the Klique Orchestrator, and running Slurm as an elastic Kubernetes service.
- [Multi-Tenancy](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/orchestration_engine/multi_tenancy.md): Klique's secure dynamic multi-tenancy architecture, including per-tenant isolation, k3k virtual clusters, identity, and RBAC.
- [Orchestration Engine](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/orchestration_engine.md): The Orchestration Engine, which connects compute resources, defines tenants, and enforces policies for self-serve access.
- [Resource Management](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/orchestration_engine/resource_policies.md): The resource dashboard, resource policies and pools, and the Platform Management Center for allocating and monitoring compute.
- [Inference Optimization](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/orchestration_engine/unified_memory_technology.md): Klique's Unified Memory Technology, which offloads inactive models to CPU RAM or disk to serve more models per GPU.
- [Conditional Templates](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/orchestrator/conditional_template.md): How to configure Conditional Templates to apply Kubernetes pod template overrides only when a specified Task field condition matches.
- [Custom Workload Configuration (K8s)](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/orchestrator/custom_workload.md): Per-queue pod template overrides and task execution settings for the Kubernetes-Glue orchestrator, including GPU resource limits.
- [Data Cache](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/orchestrator/data_caching.md): How to configure the task artifact and dataset download cache directory, including a Kubernetes pod template example.
- [Bare Metal/Virtual Machines](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/orchestrator/deployment_bare_metal.md): Installing and configuring ClearML Agent on bare-metal servers or VMs, where one process fills both the Orchestrator and Executor roles.
- [Kubernetes](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/orchestrator/deployment_k8s.md): Deploying the Kubernetes-Glue as Klique's Orchestrator via the `orchestrator` Helm chart, including installation and workload customization.
- [Slurm (Native)](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/orchestrator/deployment_slurm.md): Installing the Slurm Glue orchestrator, creating batch templates with dynamic variables, and launching it against Klique queues.
- [Slurm with Pyxis](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/orchestrator/deployment_slurm_pyxis.md): Deploying the Slurm Glue orchestrator with Pyxis containers, using SBATCH directives or a custom srun wrapper for OCI images.
- [Slurm with Singularity](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/orchestrator/deployment_slurm_singularity.md): Deploying the Slurm Glue orchestrator with Singularity containers, including batch template setup and default container configuration.
- [Dynamic Task Pod Templates](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/orchestrator/dynamic_edit_task_pod_template.md): Using CLEARML_K8S_GLUE_TEMPLATE_MODULE to inject custom Python code that dynamically modifies Kubernetes task pod templates before they run.
- [Dynamic GPU Fractions on Bare Metal and VMs](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/orchestrator/fractional_gpus/bare_metal_dynamic_fractional_gpus.md): Configuring dynamic per-task GPU memory fractions for the ClearML Agent running on bare metal or virtual machines.
- [Managing GPU Fractions with Cluster Dynamic MIG Operator (CDMO)](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/orchestrator/fractional_gpus/cdmo.md): Installing the Cluster Dynamic MIG Operator (CDMO) and assigning NVIDIA MIG GPU profiles to workloads by queue on Kubernetes.
- [Install CDMO and CFGI on the Same Cluster](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/orchestrator/fractional_gpus/cdmo_cfgi_same_cluster.md): Configuring the NVIDIA GPU Operator with multiple device plugin configurations to run CDMO and CFGI together on one Kubernetes cluster.
- [Cluster Fractional GPU Injector (CFGI)](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/orchestrator/fractional_gpus/cfgi.md): Installing the Cluster Fractional GPU Injector (CFGI) and configuring Agent queues for fractional non-MIG GPU allocation on Kubernetes.
- [K8s GPU Operator](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/orchestrator/fractional_gpus/gpu_operator.md): Deploying the NVIDIA GPU Operator on Kubernetes with the recommended configuration for use with Klique's fractional GPU features.
- [HuggingFace Cache](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/orchestrator/hf_caching.md): Configuring the HF_HOME cache directory and Kubernetes volume mounts for HuggingFace models used by the Klique Orchestrator.
- [Multi-Node Scheduling](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/orchestrator/multi_node_training.md): Configuring the Klique Orchestrator on Kubernetes to run a single Task across multiple pods and nodes for distributed training.
- [NIM Cache](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/orchestrator/nim_caching.md): Configuring the NIM_CACHE_PATH cache directory and Kubernetes volume mounts for NVIDIA NIM containers used by the Klique Orchestrator.
- [Orchestration Dashboard Customization (K8s)](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/orchestrator/orch_dash_k8s.md): Configuring GPU and CPU capacity reporting, worker ID templates, and hidden worker patterns for the Klique Orchestration Dashboard on Kubernetes.
- [Slurm User Impersonation](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/orchestrator/slurm_impersonation.md): Configuring a user_map in clearml.conf or a vault so the Slurm Orchestrator submits jobs as the Linux user mapped to each Klique user.
- [Custom Pod Manifests with String Templates](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/orchestrator/string_template.md): The CLEARML_ string template syntax, variables, and filter operators for customizing Kubernetes pod manifests in the orchestrator Helm chart.
- [Klique Orchestrator](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/orchestrator.md): The Orchestrator and Executor roles, how they map onto each compute fabric, their scheduling and execution behavior, and installation per fabric.
- [Application Management](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/platform_management_center/pmc_apps.md): The Platform Management Center Applications page for installing, deploying, and managing app versions across tenants.
- [Platform Management Center](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/platform_management_center/pmc_overview.md): Platform Management Center modules for usage and cost dashboards, tenants, volume templates, configuration template variables, and applications.
- [Platform Usage Dashboards](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/platform_management_center/pmc_platform_overview.md): The Platform Management Center's usage, orchestration, and hardware dashboards for platform-wide cost and resource visibility.
- [Configuration Template Variables](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/platform_management_center/pmc_template_variables.md): How platform administrators create configuration template variables and per-tenant overrides for use in templates.
- [Tenant Management](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/platform_management_center/pmc_tenants.md): Creating, configuring, monitoring, and deleting tenants, including their applications, volume templates, and variable overrides.
- [Volume Templates](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/platform_management_center/pmc_volumes.md): Creating and configuring storage configuration templates that tenant administrators and users apply to workloads.
- [Klique REST API Reference](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/references/api.md): The Klique Server exposes a comprehensive REST API.
- [Apps](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/references/mcp_server/apps.md): The Klique MCP server's apps module, with tools, resources, and prompts for the app catalog and for launching, monitoring, and managing app instances.
- [Events](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/references/mcp_server/events.md): The Klique MCP server's events module, with tools and a resource for a task's console log and the scalar metrics it reported.
- [Models](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/references/mcp_server/models.md): The Klique MCP server's models module, with tools and resources for the model registry and for serving endpoints and their container instances.
- [MCP Server](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/references/mcp_server/overview.md): Klique MCP server modules for apps, events, models, projects, queues, tasks, users, and workers, plus hosted skills, as tools, resources, and prompts.
- [Projects](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/references/mcp_server/projects.md): Klique MCP server's projects module, with tools to list, create, update, and delete projects, plus inspect tags, users, metrics, and hyper-parameters.
- [Queues](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/references/mcp_server/queues.md): The Klique MCP server's queues module, covering tools to manage execution queues and to enqueue, dequeue, and move tasks between them.
- [Skills](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/references/mcp_server/skills.md): The Klique MCP server's skills module, with the built-in agent skills it hosts, the klique://skills resource listing them, and how to extend them.
- [Tasks](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/references/mcp_server/tasks.md): The Klique MCP server's tasks module, with tools to list, create, clone, update, stop, archive, and delete tasks, plus a prompt to compare runs.
- [Users](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/references/mcp_server/users.md): The Klique MCP server's users module, with tools for user accounts, roles, service accounts, invitations, and per-user preferences in your company.
- [Workers](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/references/mcp_server/workers.md): The Klique MCP server's workers module, covering the tool for listing worker machines registered to pull and execute queued tasks.
- [References](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/references/references_overview.md): Klique reference pages for the ClearML SDK, Legacy SDK (allegroai), client configuration, the Orchestrator, MCP server modules, and the Server API.
- [Access Rules (RBAC)](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/user_management/access_rules.md): How workspace administrators use Access Rules to grant read-only or read-and-modify access to projects, tasks, models, and other resources.
- [Administrator Vaults](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/user_management/admin_vaults.md): Administrator Vaults, central configuration stores administrators apply to user groups via the Klique UI or REST API.
- [Identity Providers](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/user_management/identity_providers.md): Identity providers and protocols (OAuth, SAML, LDAP) Klique supports for single sign-on and user provisioning.
- [User Groups](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/user_management/user_groups.md): How administrators create user groups to manage access rules and administrator vaults at the group level.
- [Administrator Settings](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/admin_settings.md): Administrator Settings sections in the AI Admin view, such as vaults, users, access rules, identity providers, and gateways.
- [AWS Autoscaler](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/applications/apps_aws_autoscaler.md): The AWS Autoscaler application, which spins EC2 instances up and down based on queue demand and a configured resource budget.
- [Claude Code](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/applications/apps_claude_code.md): The Claude Code application, which launches a remote VS Code session pre-configured with the Claude Code CLI.
- [Claude Desktop](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/applications/apps_claude_desktop.md): The Claude Desktop application, which launches the Claude Desktop AI assistant in a browser-accessible remote desktop.
- [Codex](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/applications/apps_codex.md): The Codex application, which launches a remote VS Code session pre-configured with OpenAI's Codex CLI.
- [Containerized Application Launcher](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/applications/apps_container_launcher.md): The Containerized Application Launcher, which remotely runs application containers with network routing and persistent workspaces.
- [Project Dashboard](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/applications/apps_dashboard.md): The Project Dashboard application, which aggregates task status, metrics, and resource usage for a project or workspace.
- [Deploy Slurm Cluster](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/applications/apps_deploy_slurm.md): The Deploy Slurm Cluster application, which provisions a login node and worker nodes as a Slurm cluster on Klique queues.
- [Embedding Model Deployment](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/applications/apps_embed_model_deployment.md): The Embedding Model Deployment application, which serves embedding models over a secure network endpoint with multi-model hosting.
- [GCP Autoscaler](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/applications/apps_gcp_autoscaler.md): The GCP Autoscaler application, which spins GCP VM instances up and down based on queue demand and a configured resource budget.
- [Gradio Launcher](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/applications/apps_gradio.md): The Gradio Launcher app, which serves a model's Gradio web interface through a secure, externally accessible link.
- [Hyperparameter Optimization](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/applications/apps_hpo.md): The Hyperparameter Optimization app, which samples parameter sets across cloned tasks to find the values that best optimize a chosen metric.
- [Jupyter Lab](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/applications/apps_jupyter_lab.md): A remote Jupyter Lab session launched over SSH, with workspace persistence and configuration options for git, containers, and idle shutdown.
- [K3k Deployment](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/applications/apps_k3k.md): A K3s Kubernetes cluster with autoscaling worker nodes, kubeconfig access, and SSH login to the control plane.
- [Llama.cpp Model Deployment](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/applications/apps_llama_deployment.md): GGUF format LLM deployment with llama.cpp behind a secure endpoint, covering multi-model hosting, CPU/disk offloading, and engine configuration.
- [LLM UI](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/applications/apps_llm_ui.md): A chat interface to models served by the vLLM, Llama.cpp, and SGLang deployment apps, including RAG knowledge bases.
- [MCP Server Deployment](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/applications/apps_mcp_server.md): Remote MCP server deployment as containerized services, with preset server types like filesystem, PostgreSQL, GitHub, and Brave Search.
- [Milvus DB Session](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/applications/apps_milvus.md): A standalone, detachable Milvus vector database session with automatic serialization and workspace restore.
- [vLLM Model Deployment](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/applications/apps_model_deployment.md): LLM deployment as vLLM inference services behind a secure endpoint, covering multi-model hosting, LoRA adapters, and speculative decoding.
- [Multi-Node Trainer](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/applications/apps_multi_node_trainer.md): Distributed training job orchestration across a master node and worker nodes using frameworks like torchrun or Accelerate.
- [Nvidia Dynamo](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/applications/apps_nvidia_dynamo.md): NVIDIA's Dynamo serving framework, deployed as a multi-service stack of ETCD, NATS, frontend, and workers serving multiple LLMs behind one endpoint.
- [NVIDIA NIM](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/applications/apps_nvidia_nim.md): NVIDIA NIM models launched in their vendor containers behind a secure endpoint, requiring an NGC API key.
- [OpenCode](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/applications/apps_open_code.md): A detachable remote VS Code session pre-configured with the OpenCode CLI, with token usage metered through the LLM Gateway.
- [Klique Applications](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/applications/apps_overview.md): Klique's no-code Applications catalog, organized by category, with app deployment, deletion, launching, and publishing as URL Applications.
- [Qdrant DB Session](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/applications/apps_qdrant.md): A standalone, detachable Qdrant vector database session with automatic serialization and workspace restore.
- [SGLang Model Deployment](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/applications/apps_sglang.md): The SGLang Model Deployment application for serving LLM endpoints, its dashboard, and instance configuration options.
- [SSH Session](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/applications/apps_ssh_session.md): The SSH Session application for launching a remote development environment with an SSH session, its dashboard, and configuration options.
- [Streamlit Launcher](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/applications/apps_streamlit.md): The Streamlit Launcher application for serving Streamlit apps on remote machines, its dashboard, and instance configuration options.
- [Task Scheduler](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/applications/apps_task_scheduler.md): The Task Scheduler application for scheduling one-shot and recurring task execution, its dashboard, and configuration options.
- [Trigger Manager](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/applications/apps_trigger_manager.md): The Trigger Manager application for running tasks automatically when dataset, model, or task events occur, its dashboard, and configuration.
- [Virtual Machine Remote Desktop](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/applications/apps_vm_desktop.md): The Virtual Machine Remote Desktop application for launching a remote VM with desktop or SSH access, its dashboard, and configuration options.
- [VS Code](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/applications/apps_vscode.md): The VS Code application for launching a remote VS Code session, its dashboard, and instance configuration options.
- [Datasets Page](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/datasets/webapp_dataset_page.md): The Datasets page for browsing, filtering, and managing datasets in project and list views.
- [Dataset Details](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/datasets/webapp_dataset_viewing.md): The dataset version list, lineage graph, version details panel, and version actions such as publish, archive, and delete.
- [Pipelines Page](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/pipelines/webapp_pipeline_page.md): The Pipelines page for browsing, filtering, and managing pipelines in project and list views.
- [The Pipeline Run Table](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/pipelines/webapp_pipeline_table.md): The pipeline runs table, its columns, filtering and customization options, run creation, and run actions.
- [Pipeline Run Details](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/pipelines/webapp_pipeline_viewing.md): The pipeline run details panel, showing pipeline structure, stages, step information, and run and step details tabs.
- [Resource Policies](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/resource_policies.md): Resource policies for defining user group resource quotas and reservations across Klique queues.
- [Role-Based UI](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/role_based_ui.md): The Klique WebApp's three role-based views, AI Admin, AI Builder, and AI Consumer, and how to switch between them.
- [Access Rules (RBAC)](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/settings/webapp_settings_access_rules.md): The Access Rules page for managing role-based access permissions to projects, tasks, models, and other workspace resources.
- [Administrator Vaults](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/settings/webapp_settings_admin_vaults.md): Administrator vaults distribute client configuration, UI storage credentials, or SSH server keys to user groups, tracked in an activity log.
- [Application Gateway](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/settings/webapp_settings_app_gw.md): Application Gateway settings monitor routers, define static routes, and manage access tokens for external endpoint access to compute node jobs.
- [Identity Providers](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/settings/webapp_settings_id_providers.md): Administrators connect OIDC and SAML identity providers to enable SSO login to the Klique WebApp.
- [LLM Gateway](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/settings/webapp_settings_llm_gateway.md): LLM Gateway settings configure token quotas and register models, endpoints, and access controls for gateway-routed LLM requests.
- [Metering Service](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/settings/webapp_settings_metering_service.md): Metering Service settings define usage categories and pricing for tracking resource consumption and costs.
- [Settings Page](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/settings/webapp_settings_overview.md): The Settings page links to user profile, configuration, and workspace sections for managing personal account settings.
- [User Settings](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/settings/webapp_settings_profile.md): User Settings covers profile info, UI and storage access configuration, and workspace API credentials, gateway tokens, and configuration vault.
- [Resource Configuration](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/settings/webapp_settings_resource_configs.md): Resource Configuration settings define resource pools and profiles that allocate compute across user groups via resource policies.
- [Storage Cleanup](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/settings/webapp_settings_storage_credentials.md): Storage Cleanup settings configure Google Cloud, AWS S3, and Azure credentials used to delete task artifacts when tasks are deleted.
- [Volumes](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/settings/webapp_settings_storage_volumes.md): The Volumes settings tab creates storage volumes from templates that projects can apply to their workloads.
- [UI Customization](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/settings/webapp_settings_ui_customization.md): UI Customization settings control the task clone name template and the Hyper-Dataset new version name template.
- [Users & Groups](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/settings/webapp_settings_users.md): The Users and Groups settings tab manages workspace users, service accounts, and user groups for access control.
- [Admin Dashboard](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/webapp_admin_dashboard.md): The Admin Dashboard landing page presents Running Tasks, Metering, and AI Usage tabs for tenant-wide activity.
- [AI Usage](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/webapp_admin_dashboard_ai_usage.md): The AI Usage dashboard tab tracks LLM token consumption across the workspace from gateway and external usage sources.
- [Metering](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/webapp_admin_dashboard_metering.md): The Metering dashboard tab tracks usage and spend over time based on custom metered events.
- [Running Tasks](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/webapp_admin_dashboard_running_tasks.md): The Admin Dashboard Running Tasks tab, which lists running tasks and app instances across the tenant, including those of other users.
- [Comparing Tasks](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/webapp_exp_comparing.md): The task comparison page in the WebApp, covering side-by-side details, hyperparameter, scalar, plot, and debug sample comparison modes.
- [Reproducing Task Runs](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/webapp_exp_reproducing.md): How to reproduce task runs in the WebApp by cloning or resetting tasks and re-enqueuing them for execution.
- [The Task Table](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/webapp_exp_table.md): The WebApp task table, including creating, filtering, customizing, comparing, and performing actions on tasks.
- [Tracking Tasks and Visualizing Results](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/webapp_exp_track_visual.md): The WebApp task tabs for tracking execution, configuration, artifacts, and dataviews, and visualizing scalars, plots, and debug samples.
- [Tuning Tasks](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/webapp_exp_tuning.md): How to tune and edit a cloned task's execution details, hyperparameters, artifacts, and dataviews before re-enqueuing it in the WebApp.
- [Project Dashboard](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/webapp_home.md): The Project Dashboard, the WebApp landing page summarizing recent projects, reports, and tasks.
- [Comparing Models](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/webapp_model_comparing.md): The model comparison page in the WebApp, covering side-by-side details, tabular scalar, and plot comparison modes.
- [Model Endpoints](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/webapp_model_endpoints.md): The Model Endpoints tab, which lists live model endpoints and their details and monitoring metrics.
- [The Model Table](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/webapp_model_table.md): The WebApp model table, including its columns, customization, filtering, tagging, and model actions.
- [Model Details](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/webapp_model_viewing.md): The WebApp model details page, covering general information, configuration, label enumeration, metadata, lineage, and plots.
- [Orchestration Dashboard](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/webapp_orchestration_dash.md): The Orchestration Dashboard, which monitors available and in-use compute resources, resource groups, and usage history.
- [Klique UI](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/webapp_overview.md): The Klique WebApp structure, sidebar modules, role-based views, and top bar search and settings features.
- [Project Overview](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/webapp_project_overview.md): A project's Overview tab, which shows a metric snapshot graph and an editable project description.
- [Project Workloads](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/webapp_project_workloads.md): A project's Workloads tab, which breaks down compute execution time by resource, project, and user.
- [Projects Page](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/webapp_projects_page.md): The Projects Page for navigating project folders, filtering, configuring project settings, and creating new projects.
- [Reports](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/webapp_reports.md): Reports for writing notes and findings, embedding live visualizations from Klique objects, and the supported Markdown formatting.
- [Orchestration](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/webapp/webapp_workers_queues.md): The Orchestration page for monitoring cloud autoscalers, worker resource utilization, and managing task queues.
- [AI Application Gateway](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/whats_klique/appgw.md): Authenticated, SSL-secured routing that turns workloads on governed compute into RBAC-scoped endpoints, and publishes them as URL Applications.
- [Governed Compute](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/whats_klique/governed_compute.md): Klique bringing Kubernetes, HPC, VM, bare metal, and cloud fabrics under one set of controls, with resource pools, policies, and self-serve access.
- [Klique for AI Admins](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/whats_klique/klique_for_ai_admins.md): Klique overview for AI Admins, covering resource policies, vaults, access control, LLM governance, and usage monitoring.
- [Klique for AI Builders](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/whats_klique/klique_for_ai_builders.md): Klique overview for AI Builders, covering model development, remote development environments, and application publishing.
- [Klique for AI Consumers](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/whats_klique/klique_for_ai_consumers.md): Klique overview for AI Consumers, covering deploying models, launching agentic environments, and using published applications.
- [Klique Platform](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/whats_klique/klique_platform.md): How Klique enables an organization to build and consume AI, through self-serve compute, governed access, publishing, and measured consumption.
- [Control Plane](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/whats_klique/klique_server.md): Klique Server as the control plane, what it holds, how people, code, and agents reach it, its usage and observability, services, and deployment.
- [LLM Gateway](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/whats_klique/llm_gateway.md): Klique's centralized entry point for LLM traffic, covering model routing, load balancing, governed access, token quotas, and cost visibility.
- [Platform Management Center](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs/whats_klique/management_center.md): Administering a multi-tenant Klique deployment, with isolated tenants sharing compute, platform-wide cost and utilization, and shared config.
- [What is Klique?](https://klique.ai/docs/latest/docs.md): Klique, an enterprise AI platform built on its Orchestration, Governance, and AI engines, and who uses it.
